blockers.why: #3 Second hook by 0:30 and #15 Cold open inside the power fail: the title question arrives around 0:36, after the required window. The owner's skit exception relaxes the thumbnail timing, not this premise-question deadline.
blockers.fix: Replace lines 36–38 with: “You made the cut. So what if every piece of good news showed you who wants you to fail? You tell nobody all day. Your best friend hears everything first. He always has.” Start this narration immediately when the skit ends.

keep.quote: You stopped helping him. He never stopped helping you.
She was never outside your lane. She was in it first.
That half-second is the other life, going past.
